name: aws-quantum-computing
description: Quantum computing and hybrid algorithm engineering on Amazon Braket for the main agent: OpenQASM 3.0 & Braket SDK circuit design, Managed Simulators (SV1, DM1, TN1), QPU hardware targeting (IonQ, Rigetti, IQM, QuEra), Braket Hybrid Jobs (VQE, QAOA, PennyLane adjoint differentiation), pre-execution shot/task cost governance, and VPC/KMS security.
